αἰακίδαο: Αἰακίδης — son or descendant of Aeacus, used of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
αἱματόεντα: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-stained; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic -όεντα (= Attic αἱματηρόν), agreeing with βρότον · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’bloody’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ὄσσε: ’bloody’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self, same; masc./neut. dat. pl., intensive with a noun: ’the very …’ · also plain pronoun, masc. dat. pl.: ’them’ (ἐν δ’ αὐτοῖς ’among them’) · also plain pronoun, neut. dat. pl., of things, after ἐγκείσεαι: ’in them’ (ἐγκείσεαι αὐτοῖς ’you will lie in them’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, with a verb of leaning: ’on it’ (αὐτῷ σκηπτόμενον ’leaning on it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with ἔοικα: ’to him, like him’ (αὐτῷ … ἐῴκει ’resembled him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’with it’ (φρένες αὐτῷ ἕποντο ’the midriffs followed with it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a person, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’him’ (ἕπετ’ αὐτῷ ’followed him’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’ · also in ὣς δ’ αὔτως, ’in the same way’: ’likewise’ · also ’just as one is’ (ἀλλ’ αὔτως … φάνηθι ’but as you are, appear’)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βαρὺ: βαρύς — heavy, deep; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’heavily’
βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
βουλεύσομεν: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= Attic βουλεύσωμεν), after εἰ without κε; or fut. indic. 1 pl.
βουλὰς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
βρότον: βρότος — gore, blood from a wound; masc. acc. sg. (not βροτός ’mortal’)
βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’the limbs were loosened’ (λύντο δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of an intransitive active verb: ’the limbs trembled’ (ἔτρεμε γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of εἰμί with a predicate: ’the limbs were firm’ (ἔμπεδα γυῖα … ἦν) · also neut. acc. pl., of the part affected, after ὑπήλυθε: ’the limbs’ (τρόμος ὑπήλυθε γυῖα ’trembling crept over the limbs’)
γόοιο: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
γόου: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., depending on a noun: ’of lament’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δάκρυσι: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. dat. pl. (from the athematic stem δάκρυ-)
δάσασθαι: δατέομαι — divide, share out, carve up; aor. inf. mid. (same form in Attic): ’to share out’
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαίνυ: δαίνυμι — give a feast, entertain; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., athematic: ’give a feast’
δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀκουάζεσθον: ’hear of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. after ἐπιδευεῖς: ’short of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. dependent on ἔργα: ’the business of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’begin the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης ’the equal feast’)
δειλοῖο: δειλός — wretched, miserable, poor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with a genitive name
δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
δεύοντο: δεύω — wet, drench; impf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδεύοντο): ’were wetted’
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, of order in a sequence of attacks: ’second, next’ (δεύτερον ὁρμηθείς ’rushing second’)
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό) · also adv. before ἀμπερές: ’through, right through’
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δώσειν: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf. act., in indirect statement: ’that (you) will give’ · also fut. inf. act. after μέλλω: ’(was about) to give’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’heavenly’
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί · also without a preposition, acc. of the goal after ἱκάνω: ’to the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’) · also ὡς εἴ τε, ’as if’, in a comparison · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’, in a comparison (ὡς εἰ … πυρὶ σμύχοιτο ’as if it were smouldering in fire’)
εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’) · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ … ἕλοιεν ’until they should take’) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic εἶς (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (λελασμένος εἰς ’you have forgotten’, with a perfect participle) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (εἰς ἐνιαυτόν ’for a year’)
εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἔα- → εἴα): ’allowed’
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’clothes’
εὑόμενοι: εὕω — singe; pres. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’being singed’
εὖτέ: εὖτε — when; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ὅτε)
εὖτε: εὖτε — when; epic temporal conj. (= Attic ὅτε)
ζόφον: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (esp. of the west, where the sun sets); masc. acc. sg.
ζώοντος: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute with ἐμεῖο: ’while I am still alive’
ζῆν: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Ζῆν (elided Ζῆν’ = Ζῆνα), object of ἐξείρετο · also masc. acc. sg., subject of ἀρηξέμεν: ’that Zeus will help’
θέμεναι: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θεῖναι), with two accusatives: ’to make (you) …’
θέμενος: τίθημι — put, place, lay; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laid’
θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
θαλέθοντες: θαλέθω — bloom, flourish; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’in full bloom, thriving’
θανόντος: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg. (aor. ἔθανον): ’dead’, lit. ’having died’
θανόντων: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. gen. pl., as a noun: ’of the dead’
θεράποντ: θεράπων — attendant, squire; masc. acc. sg., elided (θεράποντα)
θινὶ: θίς (θίν-) — shore, beach, strand; dat. sg.
θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’) · also κ’ + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὁπποῖόν κ’ εἴπῃσθα ’whatever sort you say’) · also κ’ + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will, in that case’ (οἵ κ’ … κείσοντ’ ’who will lie’) · also ὄφρά κ’ + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κ’ ἔτι γνῶμεν ’so that we may learn’)
κάλ: καλός — fair, fine, goodly; neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with τεύχεα: ’fine (armour)’ · also agreeing with σφυρά: ’fair (ankles)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’fine (works)’ · also agreeing with λέπαδνα: ’fine (yoke-straps)’
κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’) · also with a direct object: ’made, wrought’ (πάνθ’ ὅπλα κάμε ’made all the arms’) · also with an acc. of respect: ’grew weary in’ (κάμε χεῖρας ’tired his hands’)
καθαρῷ: καθαρός — clean, clear; neut. dat. sg., used as a noun: ’a clear (open) place’
κακκείοντες: κατακείω — wish to lie down (desiderative of κεῖμαι); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., κακκείοντες = κατακείοντες
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’) · also κατὰ πάμπαν, adverbial: ’altogether, utterly’ · also + acc. of position, ’over’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’over the right shoulder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also ὄφρά κε + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κε … ἔλθῃσι ’until … comes’) · also + aor. subj. in a main clause, potential: ’might, would’ (τώ κε κορεσσάμεθα ’then we might have our fill’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg. act.
κεῖτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκειτο): ’lay’, also with a neut. pl. subject (ἅρματα κεῖτο ’the chariots lay’)
κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
κλισίην: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. acc. sg. (Attic κλισία)
κλύον: κλύω — hear, hearken; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they heard’
κονίῃς: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς for -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
κταμένοιο: κτείνω — kill; root aor. part. (κτάμενος), pass. sense, masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’slain’
κυσὶν: κύων — dog; masc./fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (= κυσί): ’for dogs’
κύματ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (κύματ’ = κύματα): ’waves’
κὰδ: κατά (κάδ before δ-) — down; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (κὰδ … λίποιεν = καταλίποιεν ’leave behind’)
κὴρ: κήρ — death-spirit, power of death, doom; fem. nom. sg., personified (distinct from κῆρ ’heart’)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
λελασμένος: λανθάνω — escape notice; mid. forget (+ gen.); perf. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic λελησμένος): ’forgetful, having forgotten’
λεχέεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch, bier; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic λέχεσι)
λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
λοετρὰ: λοετρόν — bath, washing water (usually plural; Attic λουτρόν); neut. acc. pl.: ’baths’
λυγρῆς: λυγρός — bitter, baneful, grievous; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. μέ, accented because an enclitic follows: ’me’
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
μήστωρα: μήστωρ — deviser, planner (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
μίνυνθά: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv., epic, accented before the enclitic περ
μαρμαίροντα: μαρμαίρω — flash, sparkle; pres. part. act., neut. acc. pl.: ’flashing’ · also pres. part. act., neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δώματα: ’gleaming’
μενοίτιος: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, son of Actor, father of Patroclus; masc. nom. sg.
μενοεικέα: μενοεικής — satisfying, to one’s heart’s desire (μένος + ἔοικα); fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μενοεικῆ) · also neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic μενοεικῆ), agreeing with πολλά: ’satisfying things’
μενοιτιάδαο: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’) · also + dat. of place: ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσί ’in the mind’) · also + acc. of pursuit: ’after’ (μετὰ πέλειαν ’after the dove’)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
μηκάδες: μηκάς — bleating; adj., fem. nom. pl. (of goats)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
μυρμιδόνας: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ own troops from Phthia; masc. acc. pl.
μυρμιδόνες: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, the people of Achilles; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Myrmidons!’
μυρμιδόνεσσιν: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
μυρόμενοι: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’lamenting’
μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
μὰ: μά — by (in oaths, + acc. of the one sworn by); particle: οὐ μά ‘no, by …’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’) · also μή ποτε + fut. inf., the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μή ποτ’ … ἀλεξήσειν ’that never will I ward off’) · μηδέ (written μὴ δ’) — and not, not even; continuing a negative (μὴ δ’ ὁπότ’ ἂν ’not even when’)
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέκυν: νέκυς — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
νεκρὸν: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg., epic νῆα
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl.: ’to whom’ (οἷς … μέλει ’to whom … is a care’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. · also + gen.: ’in front of’
πάτροκλε: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. voc. sg.
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πίθηαι: πείθομαι — be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πίθῃ)
πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
παρά: παρά — beside, by; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε · also adv./preverb in tmesis with ἵσταμαι: ’stand by’ · also prep. + acc.: ’along’ (παρά τε κλισίας καὶ νῆας ’along the huts and the ships’) · also preverb in tmesis with κιών, apart from its verb (παρά … κιών): ’passing by’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατροκλῆος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έους)
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
πείσομαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust, yield (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall obey’ · also πάσχω — suffer; fut. 1 sg. (the same form)
πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
πεπίθοιεν: πείθω — persuade; strong aor. opt. 3 pl. act., epic reduplicated (= Attic πίθοιεν), in an indirect clause after ὡς: ’they might persuade’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πηλεΐδην: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πηλεὺς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
ποδώκεα: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic -η)
ποδώκεος: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
πολέσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πολλοῖς)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
πρηνέα: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic πρηνῆ), predicative: ’headlong’
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adv. in tmesis with a verb of following: ’along with it’ (προτὶ … ἕποντο ’followed along with it’) · also + dat.: ’to, against’ (προτὶ γαίῃ ’against the ground’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
πυρῆς: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς), after ἐπιβάντ’: ’gone up on the pyre’ · also fem. gen. sg., after causal ἐπέβησ’: ’onto the pyre’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking, drink; fem. gen. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’husband’), after ἔρον: ’desire for drink’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of a verb of remembering: ’of drink’ (μεμνῆσθαι πόσιος) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of lack with ἄκμηνος: ’without drink’
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σιδήρῳ: σίδηρος — iron; masc. dat. sg., also an iron tool or weapon
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in haste, with effort’
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στενάχοντο: στενάχομαι (στενάχω) — groan, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they groaned’
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
στῆθι: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. aor. stand; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’stand!’
στῆσαι: ἵστημι — set, stand up; aor. inf. act., transitive: ’to set up’
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σχεῖν: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. inf. act. (from ἔσχον): ’to hold’
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἑταῖρον: ’your (companion)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’your (offspring)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg., object: ’a mound’
σῶν: σῶς (σάος, σόος) — safe, sound; masc. acc. sg., contracted (σῶν = σόον): ’safe’ · also σός, σή, σόν (possessive) — your; neut. gen. pl. (σῶν ὀχέων ’your chariot’)

τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τίπτέ: τίπτε — why?; interrogative adv. (= τί ποτε), printed τίπτέ before με
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’
τανύοντο: τανύω — stretch, strain; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented: ’were stretched out’
ταχύπωλοι: ταχύπωλος — with swift colts (ταχύς + πῶλος); adj., masc. nom. pl.
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχει: τεῖχος — wall, rampart; neut. dat. sg. (contracted from -εϊ)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν after δή: ’some (evil)’ (δή τι κακόν ’some evil’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’) · also masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἑλκομένοιο: ’as he was dragged’ (τοῦ δ’ ἦν ἑλκομένοιο κονίσαλος)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρίποδα: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μ’ (a girl): ’small’ (τυτθὸν ἐοῦσαν ’while I was small’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · ὁ, ἡ, τό — relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which, that’ (τὰ … πεφύκει ’that had grown’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)
φαίδιμα: φαίδιμος — shining, splendid (of limbs); neut. acc. pl.
φιλοπτολέμοισι: φιλοπτόλεμος — war-loving; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
φωνήν: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
φωτῶν: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. pl.
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., after μνήσαντο: ’remembered flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., of respect after ἀδήριτος: ’in flight’ (ἤτ’ ἀλκῆς ἤτε φόβοιο) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of what is begun, after ἦρχε: ’began the flight’ · also masc. gen. sg. after πρό: ’in the face of flight’ (πρὸ φόβοιο)
χάλκεα: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκᾶ), agreeing with κύκλα
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα) · also dual nom./acc., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρε): ’both hands’ (ἄμφω χεῖρ’)

χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ

ἀνδροφόνους: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; adj., fem. acc. pl.

ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἁδινοῦ: ἁδινός — thronging, thick-set, close-packed; adj., masc. gen. sg.
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἦγον): ’were leading’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’ · also neut. acc. sg. as an adverb: ’for the rest’ (ἄλλο … τόσον ’for the rest, so far as’)
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι

ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’

ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’willing’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)

ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)

ἐξῆρχε: ἐξάρχω — lead off, lead the way, begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.

ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιείκελ: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐπιείκελ’ = ἐπιείκελε)
ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
ἐπιτέλλεαι: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, command, give orders; pres. mid. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιτέλλῃ): ’you command’

ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐσκίδναντο: σκίδναμαι (σκεδάννυμι) — scatter, disperse; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’scattered’
ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑλλήσποντον: Ἑλλήσποντος — the Hellespont; masc. acc. sg.

ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.

ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔμαρπτε: μάρπτω — seize, grasp; impf. 3 sg.: ’was seizing’
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔντε: ἔντεα — gear, armour, equipment (neut. pl.); neut. acc. pl., elided (ἔντε’ = ἔντεα)
ἔπλευ: πέλομαι — be, become; 2 sg. mid. ἔπλευ (= ἔπλεο), aorist with present sense: ’you are, you have proved’
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
ἔρρεεν: ῥέω — flow, run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρει)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also ’each’ of a body of men, in apposition to the whole army (’each company’)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.

ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ (ἐξ … ἕντο): ’they put away (desire)’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠερόεντα: ἠερόεις — misty, murky, dim (ἠήρ ’mist’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Τάρταρον
ἠνεμόεσσαν: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept (ἄνεμος); adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
ἠρνεῖτο: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny; impf. 3 sg.: ’was refusing’
ἠϊόνος: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. gen. sg.
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. 3 pl., epic · also ’drove (a ditch), dug’ (τάφρον ἤλασαν ’drove a ditch’)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula

ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης) · also epithet of Peleus: ’horseman’ (ἱππότα Πηλεύς)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἷζον: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they sat down, were sitting’
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀλοοῖο: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὀνόμηνεν: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (Attic ὀνομάζω): ’named’
ὀστέ: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted, elided (ὀστέ’ = ὀστέα; Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’ · also masc. gen. pl. after κατά: ’down over the eyes’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν)
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄμοσσεν: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ὤμοσε(ν)): ’swore’
ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνον): ’urged on’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὄχεσφι: ὄχος — chariot, car; neut. instrumental case in -φι (= dat. pl. ὄχεσι): ’with chariots’ · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (παρ’ ὄχεσφι) · also with ὑπό, locatival: ’under the chariot’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφι ’beneath the chariot’)
ὄϊες: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic οἶες)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’)
ὑπέστην: ὑφίστημι — place under; mid. and intrans. aor. undertake, promise; aor. 1 sg. (aor. 2 of ὑφίστημι): ’I undertook’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’) · also + gen., of entreaty: ’by’ (λίσσομ’ ὑπὲρ ψυχῆς ’I beseech by your life’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὕπατος: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. nom. sg. (superlative form, from ὑπέρ)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
